response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_of_avg_quantity) as avg_product_quantity, AVG(avg_of_item_count) as avg_item_count, AVG(avg_of_share) as avg_share_of_items FROM (SELECT production_type_code, product_type_description, AVG(avg_quantity) as avg_of_avg_quantity, AVG(item_count) as avg_of_item_count, AVG(share_of_items) as avg_of_share FROM (SELECT p.product_id, p.production_type_code, pc.product_type_description, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_quantity, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) as item_count, CAST(COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Order_Items) as share_of_items FROM Products p INNER JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code GROUP BY p.product_id, p.production_type_code, pc.product_type_description) product_metrics GROUP BY production_type_code, product_type_description) type_metrics
